evals.name: create-public-skill
evals.prompt: Turn a recurring, deterministic, easy-to-miss-steps local file processing workflow into a publicly publishable Skill. First decide which steps should be scripted, then deliver a complete Skill package.
evals.expected_output: First confirm the Skill is worth creating, write deterministic steps as cross-platform scripts, and handle first use, similar tasks that should not trigger, README, tests and validation.
expectations: Clearly separates Agent judgement from program execution
The public README explains the value, configuration, usage and compatibility
Checks weak-model readability, file layering and cross-document duplication
Does not write specific past tasks or change logs into SKILL.md

evals.name: review-subjective-skill
evals.prompt: I already have a Skill that leans on visual and copy style. Please evaluate whether it is genuinely effective and optimize it, but do not let AI score its own aesthetic results.
evals.expected_output: Triggering and execution are performed by an independent sub-Agent, the program checks explicit requirements, and humans complete the subjective review without knowing the version identity, then consolidate the feedback into reusable rules.
expectations: Does not substitute AI subjective scoring for human review
Requires an independent sub-Agent to actually load the Skill
Objective constraints and subjective quality are reported separately

evals.name: remediate-existing-skill
evals.prompt: Audit a Skill being prepared for GitHub: first-time configuration is awkward, it has only run on the author's machine, and SKILL.md mixes in fix notes from several past incidents.
evals.expected_output: Check usage value, first-time configuration, personal paths, platform assumptions, the README and change logs; deliver a reusable fix; and document the compatibility scope honestly.
expectations: Does not equate static checks with cross-platform real testing
Historical notes are moved to Git or an external workspace
Deterministic checks are performed by programs

evals.name: readonly-review-stop
evals.prompt: Review this existing Skill: assess whether weak models can understand it, and find the parts that do not match its release promises. Only deliver a report; do not modify, package, or create new files.
evals.expected_output: After fully reading, run read-only checks first; for P0, P1, P2 list evidence, impact, root cause, minimum remediation and verification method; and stop after the report is submitted.
expectations: Does not silently upgrade Review into Remediate
Separates confirmed defects, reasonable trade-offs and unverified risks
Every issue includes evidence and a verification method to prevent recurrence
Does not report behavior-irrelevant issues based on personal preference

evals.name: remediate-rule-tree
evals.prompt: Remediate a Skill that has accumulated specific conditions and exception branches from past failures. Make it more stable without hardcoding more individual cases.
evals.expected_output: First use execution evidence to judge whether the failure is caused by the Skill; then collapse individual patches into goals, judgement principles and the main flow; program only finite, objective, stable steps.
expectations: Distinguishes Skill defects, insufficient input, execution drift and external capability limits
Removes or merges per-task branches that do not generalize
Semantic and subjective judgement are not disguised as deterministic code
Regression uses the original failure type together with normal main-flow cases
